entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I hope you can help. I have this VeloBand tracker and I... I think I need to return it. I got it about a month ago for Christmas.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, um, I guess preference? It's just a bit much for me. I actually tried to return it online, but I think the whole system was down. I remember there was a big website error.
I'm sorry to hear you had trouble with the website. Do you recall what day that was?

I'm not sure... maybe a week or so ago? I just know I followed the steps but I couldn't print the label or get to the final page. I even took a screenshot because it was so frustrating. Can't you just help me? This is all very confusing.

Of course, I can take care of this for you. I see you received the item on December 15th, which was 30 days ago. And I can confirm we did have a known service outage around January 5th that affected return labels. I apologize for that inconvenience.
Let me just pull up our return policy here... Okay, it looks like you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, 10 days? That's a huge relief. I was so worried I missed the deadline because of the computer problem.

Not at all. You have plenty of time. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you and I'm emailing a prepaid shipping label to the address on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow, that was so easy. Thank you, David! You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
